description.value: Pelicana Chicken is a location of the well-known Korean fried chicken chain, situated on busy Robson Street in downtown Vancouver. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating, serving Korean-style chicken dishes. Its central downtown location on a major commercial strip makes it an easy refueling stop for cyclists passing through the city core.
